attributes.name: Karzoug Statue
attributes.powers:
The Karzoug Statue is immune to the Attack and Mental traits.

If undefeated, each character at this location takes 1d4-1 Combat damage; do not reset your hand at the end of the turn.

"But fear not. Your sons' gilded corpses will be returned. Let them be an enduring reminder, both of precision's necessity and that all things within this domain belong to me."—Karzoug, Runelord of Greed, to his vaultkeeper
